content.title: When Does the Next Episode of ‘Euphoria’ Come Out? Season 3 Release Schedule, Episode Count and More
content.text: Key PointsEuphoria Season 3 premieres April 12, 2026, after a four-year hiatus.The final season features Rue’s continued struggles and volatile relationships among main characters.Season 3 has 8 episodes, airing Sundays on HBO and HBO Max. It has been more than four years since the last episode of Euphoria aired on HBO, but the long wait is finally over. The Zendaya-led series returned on April 12, 2026, with what is expected to be its third and final season. That gap has only intensified interest, with viewers eager to see how the story continues after the emotional and chaotic events of Season 2. Created by Sam Levinson, Euphoria has built a reputation as one of HBO’s defining modern dramas. Since its debut in 2019, the series has stood out for its bold visual style, heavy use of music, and unflinching look at addiction, identity, trauma, and relationships. The show blends heightened, almost dreamlike storytelling with grounded emotional arcs, which has helped it resonate strongly with younger audiences. 🎬 SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 At the center of the story is Rue Bennett, played by Zendaya, whose struggle with addiction continues to anchor the series. Season 3 is expected to pick up after Rue’s fragile attempt at sobriety, raising questions about whether she can maintain stability or fall back into destructive patterns. Around her, the lives of Jules (Hunter Schafer), Maddy (Alexa Demie), Cassie (Sydney Sweeney), and Nate (Jacob Elordi) remain volatile, with unresolved tensions likely to shape the final chapter. Season 2 ended with fractured relationships and several characters at turning points. Rue’s apology tour, Cassie’s emotional spiral, and Nate’s shifting loyalties all left open threads. Season 3 is expected to not only move the story forward, but also to conclude the show. In an interview on The Drew Barrymore Show, Zendaya suggested that Season 3 is likely the last. Keep reading for the full episode release schedule and everything else you need to know about how to watch Euphoria Season 3. Related: ‘Euphoria’ Season 3 Cast Guide: Who’s Back, Who’s Gone and the Surprising New Additions When is the premiere date for Euphoria Season 3? Euphoria Season 3 premiered on April 12, 2026. Related: ‘Euphoria’: Zendaya Reveals if Season 3 Will Be the Last of the HBO Show How many episodes are in Euphoria Season 3? Season 3 will consist of 8 episodes. When do new episodes of Euphoria Season 3 come out? New episodes of Euphoria release on Sundays on HBO. Here’s the full season schedule: Sunday, April 12, 2026 – Episode 1 Sunday, April 19, 2026 – Episode 2 Sunday, April 26, 2026 – Episode 3 Sunday, May 3, 2026 – Episode 4 Sunday, May 10, 2026 – Episode 5 Sunday, May 17, 2026 – Episode 6 Sunday, May 24, 2026 – Episode 7 Sunday, May 31, 2026 – Episode 8 How to watch Euphoria Season 3? The show is available to watch on HBO. Episodes air at 9:00 pm E.T., and can be streamed after the fact on HBO Max. Who is in the cast of Euphoria Season 3? In addition to Zendaya, Demie, Schafer, Sweeney and Elordi, the show will feature Maude Apatow, Nika King, Colman Domingo, Dominic Fike, Martha Kelly and Chloe Cherry in returning roles. Eric Dane will appear posthumously in his final TV appearance. Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje and Toby Wallace have been added to the cast for Season 3. A few cast members have left the show. They include Barbie Ferreira, Storm Reid, Algee Smith, Javon Walton and Austin Abrams. Angus Cloud, who passed away in 2023, is not in the new season.
